en: A sepia-toned postcard showing a baroque-style church on a street corner. The church has a façade with niches containing statues, a central arched doorway, and a bell tower with a clock and onion-shaped dome topped by a cross. Tram or trolley wires run across the sky above the street. At the bottom margin of the image, white printed text identifies the location as the 'Graz – Welische Kirche'.
